nl: Write the relative paths of all .md files in docs/api/ (recursively) to api-pages.txt, one path per line, sorted, with '/' as separator and without a leading './'.
oracle_program: find "docs/api" glob: "**/*.md" type: file sort: name |> select relative |> write "api-pages.txt" format: lines
reference_bash: find docs/api -type f -name '*.md' | sed 's|^\./||' | LC_ALL=C sort > api-pages.txt
